prerequisites: R13-A corrected replay leaves exactly one delayed specimen among 128 identities
trial 0:28 has T=2/S0=1 and one current-trial owner refill_stock(...,1) on the future stock CPU
R13-A promotion was withheld only because refill kprobe nmissed=1

phase_gating: enable refill1 only from current STARTUP PRE through immediately before measured touch 1
disable refill probe outside that premeasurement interval
during each measured touch switch the same refill probe to target refill63 only
enable Q64 only during measured touch windows
observer.attribution: later boundary owner_memcg + stock_cpu retrospectively matched only inside current trial epoch
observer.zero_miss_requirement: refill1 premeasurement delta, measured Q64 deltas, and measured refill63 deltas must all have missed == 0

classifications.SMALL_RESIDUAL_REFILL_ESTABLISHMENT: zero-miss T>1 specimen whose current-trial owner refill1 sum covers S0=T-1 and has no preboundary owner refill63
classifications.T1_NO_OWNER_REFILL1: T=1 and no current-trial owner refill1
classifications.T1_WITH_OWNER_REFILL1: T=1 with owner refill1 history but no delayed boundary
classifications.DELAY_WITHOUT_OWNER_REFILL1: T>1 and no matching owner refill1
classifications.OWNER_REFILL1_PARTIAL: T>1 but observed owner refill1 sum is smaller than S0
classifications.CLASSIC_REFILL63_PREBOUNDARY: owner refill63 exists before boundary outside the measured boundary touch
classifications.INVALID_OBSERVER: any probe miss, owner ambiguity, PTE growth, CPU mismatch, worker error, trace gap, cpuset receipt failure, or multi-process cgroup

promotion_rule: all promoted evidence is inside current-trial STARTUP PRE to boundary PRE
zero misses on all phase-gated critical probe intervals

planning_sensitivity.basis: two T=2 observations across 160 CPUSET-style identities in R12 + R13-A; used only as a weak planning signal
planning_sensitivity.warning: not a population-rate estimate; stage1 is intentionally short

next_if_no_capture: strategy review before any additional 32-identity stage; no automatic scale expansion
